adjudication_summary: Targeted re-review repaired the parser-missed activity tables from primary XML Table 2/3, matched the DBAASP assay rows to those primary-source records, preserved one APD6 text-only row as database-only, and bounded the mechanism layer to source-supported antiviral activity plus explicit cautions.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: DBAASP assay and literature rows now have primary XML Table 1/2/3 or article-meta traceability; the APD6 AP04700 row remains database_only_no_primary_source because the linked local row is unstructured text without a source-verifiable sequence field.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 table-shape blocker is resolved: XML Table 2 and Table 3 support nine quantitative CC50/IC50 rows with units, targets, conditions, and locators. ND rows for B2 and K3K4B2 are preserved outside activity_records.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Mechanism claims are accepted only as phenotypic antiviral evidence and author-bounded inference; no direct membrane damage assay is promoted to direct mechanism.
per_layer_decision_rationale.worker_6_final_decision: No blocking or major rework target remains after source review; final status is accepted_with_cautions rather than accepted_clean.

caution_findings.evidence_context: APD6 AP04700 text-level IC50 annotation matches the primary K4K20K27S4 Table 3 value, but no structured APD6 sequence/name row was locally linked; retained as database_only_no_primary_source.
Packet and landed source inventory contain XML/PDF/OA package members but no separate supplementary assets or supplementary tables.
Antiviral mechanism is bounded to phenotypic pre-incubation/FACS evidence and author inference; direct envelope-damage assays were not present locally.
